930 likes, 31 comments - chitwangarg on March 30, 2026: "Still processing how SURREAL this experience was ✨♥️

Thank you @idfreshfood & @musthafapcofficial sir for inviting me to Bangalore to be a part of the #TransparenSee campaign

From watching the fresh batters being made in real time to witnessing the level of hygiene, honesty & ethics that go behind something as everyday as idli-dosa batter… it truly changed the way I look at packaged food 🥘 

Transparency isn’t just a buzzword here, it’s something you can actually see, feel & trust 🧿

And waking up to see myself on the front page of TOI?! 🥹
Never imagined I’d be featured alongside such renowned names from the industry😃

I’ve always been a customer of ID Fresh - it’s been a constant in my kitchen for years. Never in my wildest dreams did I think I’d one day be associated with the brand, let alone represent it

Truly grateful for moments like these 💛".

1,822 likes, 56 comments - chitwangarg on July 18, 2025: "THANK YOU #IHSS @foodpharmer @farmleyin @akash92sharma - this is surely an evening to remember ! 🫶
Over the past 5 years i have got SO many calls from various events/ publications - to accept awards after “paying” them an exorbitant amount of money. I have always turned those down- not because i cannot afford it , but because i always thought whats even the point ?

Thank you - jury of IHSS- for recognising my work 🧿 I’m deeply grateful for this. When I started sharing nutrition and fitness content, it was just about helping one person at a time. To see it grow into something that reaches and supports thousands—it’s humbling and incredibly motivating. Thank you for believing in my mission.

Brb cryinggg 🫶".

Dahi Paneer Kebab 🥣🌱

Serves: 1
~475 kcal | ~37 g protein

Ingredients
Low-fat paneer - 70 g
Carrot - 1 (grated)
Onion - ½ (finely chopped)
Capsicum - ¼ cup (chopped)
Beans - ¼ cup (chopped)
Ginger-garlic paste - ½ tbsp
Salt - to taste
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp
Hung curd/Greek yogurt - 200 g
Roasted besan - 2 tbsp
Oats - 20 g
Coriander leaves - 1 cup
Mint leaves - ½ cup
Cashew - 4 (soaked)
Garlic - 2 cloves
Ginger - ½ inch
Lemon juice - 1 lemon
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp

Method
1. In a bowl, add crumbled paneer, grated carrot, onion, capsicum, beans and ginger-garlic paste.
2. Add hung curd/Greek yogurt, roasted besan, oats, salt and red chilli powder. Mix everything well.
3. Shape the mixture into kebabs.
4. Cook the kebabs on a pan or air fry until golden brown and cooked through.
5. For the dressing, blend coriander leaves, mint leaves, soaked cashews, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, salt and red chilli powder until smooth.
6. Serve the dahi paneer kebabs hot with the coriander-mint dressing. 🌿

2,521 likes, 12 comments - chitwangarg on September 27, 2026: "Shawarma Paneer Crispy Rice Bowl 🌯🥗

Serves: 1 
~430 kcal | ~40g protein

Ingredients
For the crispy rice:
* Daawat Basmati Brown Rice – 80 g, cooked
* Olive oil – ½ tsp
* Red chilli powder – ¼ tsp
* Black pepper – ⅛ tsp
* Salt – to taste

For the shawarma paneer:
* Low-fat paneer – 100 g
* Red chilli paste- 1 tsp
* Salt to taste
* Black pepper- ¼ tsp

For the salad:
* Cucumber – ½ medium, diced
* Tomatoes – ½ cup, halved
* Red onion – ¼ small, finely sliced
* ⁠Lettuce –  ½ cup, chopped

For the dressing:
* Greek yogurt– 100 g
* Salt to taste
* Black pepper- ¼ tsp 
* Roasted sesame seeds – ½ tbsp

Method
* Mix cooked Daawat Basmati Brown Rice with olive oil and spices. Air fry at 190°C for 8–12 minutes until crispy.
* Coat low-fat paneer with red chilli paste, salt, pepper. Saute on a non stick pan till golden and charred.
* Add cucumber, tomatoes, onion, lettuce in a bowl.
* Whisk together greek yogurt, salt, pepper, roasted sesame seeds to make a smooth dressing.
* Assemble the salad with crispy rice and shawarma paneer. Pour the dressing on top, mix and serve.

I’ve used @daawatofficial Brown Basmati Rice in this recipe, a whole grain and a source of fibre, vitamins and minerals. With World Heart Day this month, it’s a simple reminder that small choices in our everyday meals can matter. ❤️

3,262 likes, 11 comments - chitwangarg on September 23, 2026: "FIRST TIME EVERRRR - Pink Guava Chia Pudding 🍈🥣

Serves: 1
~390 kcal | ~39 g protein

Ingredients
Ace Blend Pink Guava Protein Powder - 1 scoop
Cold water - 120–150 ml
Chia seeds - 2½ tbsp
Fresh pink guava - ½ (sliced)
Sunflower seeds - 1 tsp
Roasted flax seeds - ½ tsp
Pumpkin seeds - 1 tsp
Date syrup - ½ tsp

Method
1. In a bowl, mix guava flavour protein powder with cold water until smooth.
2. Add chia seeds and mix well.
3. Refrigerate until the chia seeds absorb the liquid and the mixture thickens.
4. Top with sliced pink guava, sunflower seeds, roasted flax seeds and pumpkin seeds.
5. Drizzle with date syrup and enjoy chilled! 🍈✨

I’ve used @ace.blend Pink Guava Protein to make this chia pudding, it gives the recipe a delicious guava flavour while adding 30 g of plant protein in one serving.
